main.summary: Internal exception describing a failed staged-file rollback.
main.remarks: Preserves the destination, backup, and staging paths so recovery artifacts can be identified without deleting ambiguous files. The underlying filesystem error is available as the inner exception.

property.name: BackupPath
property.summary: Gets the path of the original-file backup, when available.

property.name: StagingPath
property.summary: Gets the path of the staged replacement, when available.
